hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.status: HS-Stroke is the discovery cohort; R4's EEGNet benchmark run (S2, seeds 42-44, L/C/P) was planned but never completed, so no EEGNet benchmark outcome on these arms exists. TS+LR outcomes on the same arms are known (R4, C7).
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H1: EEGNet LEAKED - PLACEBO balanced accuracy > 0 (participant-level, 14 participants, exact sign-flip)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H2: EEGNet LEAKED - PLACEBO exceeds TS+LR's on the same arms and seeds (C7 frozen R4 estimator decisions)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H3: the learning-curve support bound CLEAN - LCB is below half of LEAKED - PLACEBO (0.5 x (L - P) - (C - LCB) > 0)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.descriptive: absolute BA per arm, PLACEBO - CLEAN, LEAKED - CLEAN, exposed-only / unexposed-only, probability-scale contrasts, TS+LR on the same arms, support-bound / identity ratio
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.reporting_rule: benchmark-level BA and probability contrasts are reported as such; trial-level identity-swap contrasts (C2) are never described as benchmark inflation
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold

design.arms: R4 frozen G2 manifest: LEAKED, PLACEBO (rows equal), CLEAN, LCB
design.model: EEGNet-8,2 as R4/C2; LEAKED/PLACEBO as one CRN pair; CLEAN and LCB with the same init seed
design.unit: participant (14); BA pooled over scored trials per participant, mean over seeds
